Definition: from G129 and G4482; to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage:--diseased with an issue of blood.
BiblicalUsage: haimorrhéō is how Scripture says to suffer a flow of blood. In Matthew 9:20, the text says "which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, haimorrhéō means to suffer a flow of blood, nothing more and nothing less.
RelatedEvents: Jairus' Daughter and the Bleeding Woman
